source_note: Transcribed from full-resolution card images sent 2026-11-05. Numbers read off the card face: cost top-left, life on the heart, strength bottom-right. SW Zone's setup sheet lists the starting units and marks events as 2 copies.

cards.name: Ret-Talus
cards.ability: Once per turn during your Summon Phase, you may add 2 damage to this unit to retrieve an Undead unit from your discard pile and place it adjacent to this unit.

cards.name: Elut-Bal
cards.ability: When paying costs to summon this unit, you must also destroy a friendly unit. Replace the destroyed unit with this unit.

cards.name: Gul-Dass
cards.ability: Wrath: this unit has +1 strength for each damage it has. Spawn: you may summon commons adjacent to this unit; after summoning a common adjacent to it, add 1 damage to this unit.

cards.name: Dragos
cards.ability: Before this unit attacks, it may destroy a friendly unit within 2 spaces. If it does, during that attack special results count as melee hits.
cards.source: card photo + owner clarification (special = melee hit), 2026-11-05

cards.name: Hellfire Cultist
cards.ability: After this unit is destroyed, add 1 damage to each enemy unit that was adjacent to it.

cards.name: Undead Archer
cards.ability: After a unit within 3 spaces of this unit is destroyed during your turn, you may replace the destroyed unit with this unit.

cards.name: Undead Carrier
cards.ability: Soulless: do not gain magic when this unit destroys an enemy unit. Infect: after this unit destroys a unit, you may replace the destroyed unit with a Carrier from your discard pile.

cards.name: Sacrificial Pyre
cards.ability: ACTIVE: each time a unit is destroyed, boost this card. When this card is discarded, target a unit and remove 1 damage from it for each boost on this card.

cards.name: Purge
cards.ability: Target any number of friendly units. For each target you may add 2 damage to an adjacent unit. Destroy each target.

cards.name: Hellforged Weapon
cards.ability: Place this card under a friendly common: it has +2 strength and Cursed (after it attacks, add damage to it equal to the number of hits rolled).

cards.name: Blood Summon
cards.ability: Resolve up to 3 times: target a friendly unit; choose an Undead or Cultist unit in your hand and place it adjacent to the target. If you do, add 2 damage to the target.

cards.name: Undead Warrior
cards.ability: Blood Fury: each time a unit is destroyed on your turn, boost this unit; at the end of your turn remove 2 boosts from it. Imbued Strength: +1 strength per boost, to a maximum of +5.
